subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding checklist & PO issuance cadence (Acme)
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@acme-data.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@acme-data.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + requested onboarding docs for Redwood pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we're excited to get the pilot started. Finance asked me to send the standard vendor onboarding attachments and to confirm how you want POs to be issued for the trial and subsequent paid work.

Attached: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (fillable), W-9 and bank details will follow in a secure Doc.

Two quick questions to help our procurement team:
- Do you require separate POs per milestone or a single blanket PO for the pilot?
- Is there a preferred line-item structure so finance can map costs to internal charge codes?

If helpful, I can hop on a 20-min call with Marcus and your procurement lead tomorrow morning PST.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Partnerships
Acme Data Solutions

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@acme-data.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + requested onboarding docs for Redwood pilot

Hi Samantha — great to meet you in the demo. Welcome aboard.

Short answers up front:
- For pilots we prefer a single PO covering the pilot scope (saves admin overhead) with line-items broken out by SKU/task so we can track spend and usage against each capability.
- We ask vendors to use the attached line-item template so our AP team can ingest the charges into our ERP without manual mapping.

I've attached our expected line-item template (line-item-template.xlsx) and a one-page checklist for onboarding. Marcus — looping you in to confirm timing and any exceptions.

Proposed timeline:
1) Vendor returns filled onboarding form + bank docs by Nov 24
2) Redwood issues pilot PO by Nov 26
3) Pilot start Nov 29 (systems connectivity & test calls first week)

If your procurement requires per-milestone POs for compliance, we can do a master PO + sub-POs; flag it now so we don't block issuance.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: line-item-template.xlsx, onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Procure Team <procure@acme-data.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@acme-data.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Intro + requested onboarding docs for Redwood pilot

On Fri, Nov 21, 2025 at 08:03 Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samantha — great to meet you in the demo. Welcome aboard.
> 
> Short answers up front:
> - For pilots we prefer a single PO covering the pilot scope ...
> 
Thanks for the clarity, Kimberly. We can complete the vendor-onboarding-form.pdf and return the bank docs via DocuSign by COB Nov 24.

About the PO: Acme's internal process is to raise POs per invoice when suppliers are on monthly billing terms, but for pilots we can accept a master PO and then invoice against line items. One question from our AP lead: what level of granularity do you want for the 'description' field?

Suggested mapping options:
- Option A (preferred by Acme): SKU-level lines with unit price, quantity, and one-line description.
- Option B (preferred by Redwood per prior note): Task-oriented lines (e.g., "integration hours", "volume tokens") plus internal charge code.

We can adopt whichever lets us keep invoice generation simple; please confirm your ingestion preference and Marcus's charge-code format.

Regards,
Procurement — Acme Data Solutions

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Procure Team <procure@acme-data.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@acme-data.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + requested onboarding docs for Redwood pilot

Thanks — quick alignment below so AP can proceed: 

1) Line-item granularity: go with SKU-level lines (Acme Option A) but include an extra column for "Redwood charge code" (4-digit code) so our ERP can map automatically. I'll paste the codes below for the pilot:
   - 4101: Integration services
   - 4202: Pilot compute consumption
   - 4303: Model serving license

2) PO cadence: we'll issue a single master PO for the pilot (covering Nov 29–Dec 31) and Acme should invoice monthly against the master PO referencing the Redwood PO number. That keeps your invoicing per-month while we get a single procurement record.

3) Timeline: once the onboarding PDF + bank docs are received by COB Nov 24, procurement will generate the master PO and send for signature Nov 26. Expect the signed PO to appear as a DocuSign link in the related_links above.

4) Attachments & next steps: Kimberly — please confirm the final onboarding-checklist.pdf name and I'll confirm the DocuSign when generated. Dev — can you confirm there are no special firewall ports needed for test calls next week?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference
